method: 60 seconds, 50ms ticks, production attacks/scenes/zones/enemy status updates; includes actual poison, burn and bleed. All 483 poetry lines at legal maximum levels, plus their legal level-6 subset. Four-character controls sample up to 24 distinct mechanical profiles per attribute at their legal level-6 maximum, evenly across sorted configuration keys; samples are equally weighted, not word-frequency weighted and not every short-word recipe. Compare maximum development separately from common level 6 and normalize actual construction+upgrade investment. Eight tightly clustered stationary high-HP targets favor area skills. Boss is the base ground Boss with no healing/casting/retaliation/summons/shields or half-health transitions in this fixture. No ally support, travel, kills, tower damage or utility is monetized here; real endless tests evaluate those outcomes.
